title: Previous Physiotherapy

positions.as_written: Ask whether they have had physiotherapy, then ask how many sessions and over how long.
Ask what it involved: exercises, manual treatment, acupuncture, machines, or advice.
Ask whether they were given exercises to do at home, and then ask whether they did them, and how often.
Ask whether anything helped, anything made it worse, and why they stopped.
Ask whether they were discharged, stopped attending, or ran out of appointments, since these are different.
Saying that the programme has to happen first, with a specific duration and a review date, is a clinical decision and should be recorded as one.
